problem.principle: Do not treat deleted-session volatile state as resumable authority. Instead reduce repeated operator actions in the next fresh session by deterministically rematerializing the already reviewed Step-1 prefix 00..09 from the exact frozen source/manifest in one reviewed transport action, with full local verification and journal reconstruction before allowing chunk 10.

preconditions: Fresh authority/binding check immediately before delivery
exact_v15_design.source_of_truth: Fresh-fetch exact reviewed v2/v3 Step-1 source bytes and authoritative manifest; prior chat payloads and deleted-session files are not source authority.
exact_v15_design.required_effect: One exact reviewed action must derive or carry the exact bytes for chunks 00..09, verify every length/hash before commit, create each chunk with no-follow/exclusive semantics and mode 0400, append the same ordered CHUNK_ACCEPTED journal events with fsync, then reload and assert exact INIT_PASS plus 00..09 journal state and exact root file set. It must emit exactly one fixed nonsecret PREFIX_00_09_PASS marker on success.
exact_v15_design.failure_effect: Any mismatch, existing unexpected file, journal mismatch, path/mode/owner anomaly, write/fsync failure, or unexpected output is terminal: fixed nonsecret failure marker, STOP, delete Codespace, no repair/retry/re-entry under that receipt.
exact_v15_design.next_after_success: After a Fresh authority check, continue with unchanged authoritative CHUNK 10, then 11, 12, ASSEMBLE/SOURCE/RETRIEVAL and the unchanged reviewed v14/v13 diagnostic-only chain.

lab_questions: Does the design avoid treating deleted-session progress as portable authority while still materially reducing repeated iPhone actions?
Can one prefix action reproduce exactly the same journal/file state as ten individually accepted authoritative chunk actions 00..09 without changing decoded Step-1 bytes or later semantics?
Are O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW, mode/owner/hash/fsync and exact journal/root-set assertions sufficient to preserve the prior fail-closed transport properties?
Does success lead only to unchanged chunk 10 and later reviewed diagnostic-only chain, with no OAuth/device-code/probe/production/Runtime authority expansion?
Must any additional invariant be frozen before an exact live command is authored and reviewed?
